name: 非专利检索
description: Non-patent literature search tools for the agent. Ships CNKI (China National Knowledge Infrastructure) paper search and full-text reading with automatic IP-based login; other academic databases can be added as further CNKI-style tool families.

agentTools.name: CNKI_ScanPaper
agentTools.description: Search CNKI (中国知网) academic literature by subject keyword (主题字段) and return, for each hit, Title, Href (the abstract page), Abstract, and HTML_READING_URL (the online HTML reading link, the input for CNKI_GetPaperMainBody). Login is automatic (IP-based, the CNKI whitelist of the current network); no cookie handling is needed or exposed. The search itself is one request; with withDetails (default true) each returned paper costs one extra throttled request for its abstract page, so keep pageSize small (default 10, maximum 50). Detail requests never fail the search: unavailable pages leave Abstract/HTML_READING_URL empty and are listed in warnings. If warnings report human verification, wait a few minutes or call again with withDetails=false, which makes exactly one request like the original CNKI MCP. Impact factors are not included.

value.description: Search keyword(s) for the CNKI subject field (主题).

pageSize.description: How many papers to return, 1-50 (default 10). CNKI serves pages of 10/20/50; the request is rounded up to the nearest tier and paginated as needed. With withDetails every paper adds one throttled abstract-page request (about 1.2-2 s each).

pageNum.description: One-based CNKI result page to start from (default 1).

withDetails.description: Read each hit's abstract page for Abstract and HTML_READING_URL (default true). Set false for a single-request search that returns only Title and Href, e.g. when CNKI has just asked for human verification or when only titles are needed.

agentTools.name: CNKI_GetPaperMainBody
agentTools.description: Fetch the full text of one CNKI paper from its HTML_READING_URL (as returned by CNKI_ScanPaper) and return it as plain text: the title, then each chapter heading followed by its paragraphs. No HTML, no JSON, no escape sequences. Only papers whose full text the current CNKI subscription may read are available; otherwise a structured error explains why.

href.description: The HTML_READING_URL of one paper, exactly as returned by CNKI_ScanPaper.
